performance.verdict: Tracking is broken; 10 Google conversions exist but zero leads register.

findings.text: Zero leads recorded across all 28 days despite Google Ads logging 10 conversions and 124 clicks — conversion-to-CRM pipeline is severed, not a true drought.
Booking bot battle-test was due 2026-07-31 and shows no completion event; speed-to-lead automations are unvalidated with intake ownership also unconfirmed since Vivian left 7/7.
GBP actions dropped 50% week-over-week (last 3 days: 0, 0, 0 vs prior 3: 3, 1, 2) — organic engagement has collapsed at the same time paid spend fell to ~$14/day.
Google spend is erratic: ranges from $0 to $130.18 on single days with no discernible pattern, suggesting budget pacing or campaign-pause issues rather than intentional throttle.
Search clicks rose 133% week-over-week yet GA4 sessions remain zero for all 45 days — GA4 tracking is either misconfigured or uninstalled on the live site.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL intake pipeline: trace where Google's 10 conversions disappear before reaching CRM contacts/opportunities.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads logged 10 conversions and 124 clicks in the 28-day window, but GHL shows 0 leads — the handoff between Google conversion events and CRM intake is broken. Audit the webhook or form destination that routes Google leads into GHL, and confirm who owns the intake seat following Vivian's departure on 7/7. Also complete the overdue booking bot battle-test (due 2026-07-31) and document the active intake owner with GHL login confirmed. Success: at least 1 verified test lead flows end-to-end in GHL by 2026-09-05.

suggestions.text: Reinstall or reconnect GA4 tag on live site — 45 consecutive days of zero sessions confirms tag is absent.
suggestions.monday_update: GA4 sessions have read zero for every one of the last 45 days while search clicks rose 133% week-over-week to 46 — the tag is not firing on the live WordPress/Squarespace property. Verify GA4 measurement ID is present in the site's tag manager or theme header, publish, and confirm sessions appear in the GA4 real-time view. Success: non-zero GA4 sessions recorded within 24 hours of fix, confirmed by 2026-09-03.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP daily actions: 3 consecutive zero days (Aug 28–30) — re-check after F1 fix confirms lead flow is real.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit zero on each of the last 3 days (Aug 28, 29, 30), down from a prior-3-day average of 2 and a mid-August peak of 17 on Aug 19. This may be Windsor data lag (SOW flags last 2–3 days of any GBP window as unreliable) or a genuine organic drop tied to reduced paid activity. Do not act on GBP alone until the intake fix (S1) is confirmed and at least 5 more days of GBP data are available. Re-check on 2026-09-05.
